import sqlite3

# Get existing reminder

existing = cursor.fetchone()
print('Existing reminder:', existing)

# Get current location
cursor.execute('SELECT * FROM ts_location')
loc = cursor.fetchone()
print('Current location:', loc)

# Create new reminder with same content and time, but at current location
title = existing[1]
time_trigger = existing[2]
location_trigger = f'{loc[0]},{loc[1]}'
reminder_list = existing[4]

cursor.execute('INSERT INTO ts_reminders (title, time_trigger, location_trigger, list) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)',
               (title, time_trigger, location_trigger, reminder_list))
conn.commit()

# Verify
cursor.execute('SELECT * FROM ts_reminders')
all_reminders = cursor.fetchall()
print('All reminders after insert:', all_reminders)
conn.close()
"")
print(result)
